metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did sourthern African countries (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS daily rainfall dataset (ee.ImageCollection("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY")) - Date range for analysis: Dec 2018 - Jan 2019 - Date range for climatology: Dec 2000 - Jan 2019 (all Dec-Jan periods) - Locations: Three countries (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho) - Calculate total rainfall for Dec 2018-Jan 2019 and compare to long-term average 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS is a rainfall product, no cloud masking needed - Need to filter for valid data and handle any gaps 3. Logic: - For each country, calculate: * Total rainfall Dec 2018 - Jan 2019 * Average total rainfall for all Dec-Jan periods from 2000-2019 * Compare: If 2018-19 < long-term average for all 3 countries → A (Yes) * If 2018-19 >= long-term average for any country → B (No) - Check for data availability (C1 if missing) - Check for valid pixels (C2 if none) - Validate results are realistic (C3 if invalid) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define country geometries const namibia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([11.7, -28.97, 25.26, -16.96]); const botswana = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([19.99, -26.87, 29.62, -17.79]); const lesotho = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([27.0, -30.67, 29.45, -28.6]); const countries = { 'Namibia': namibia, 'Botswana': botswana, 'Lesotho': lesotho }; const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // Calculate rainfall for Dec 2018 - Jan 2019 const rainfall_2018_19 = chirps .filterDate('2018-12-01', '2019-02-01') .sum(); // Calculate climatology: all Dec-Jan periods from 2000-2019 let climatology_2018_19 = ee.Image(0); let count_years = 0; for (let year = 2000; year < 2019; year++) { const dec_jan = chirps.filterDate(year + '-12-01', (year + 1) + '-02-01').sum(); climatology_2018_19 = climatology_2018_19.add(dec_jan); count_years++; } climatology_2018_19 = climatology_2018_19.divide(ee.Image(count_years)); print('Years in climatology:', count_years); let all_below = true; for (const [country, geom] of Object.entries(countries)) { // Get rainfall for 2018-19 const val_2018_19 = rainfall_2018_19.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Get climatological average const val_clim = climatology_2018_19.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Check for data validity if (val_2018_19 === null || val_clim === null || isNaN(val_2018_19) || isNaN(val_clim)) { print(country + ' data invalid'); print('C3'); return; } const below = val_2018_19 < val_clim; print(country + ': 2018-19=' + val_2018_19.toFixed(1) + 'mm, Clim=' + val_clim.toFixed(1) + 'mm, Below=' + below); if (!below) { all_below = false; } } print('---'); if (all_below) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
